T0158.title: Data Lookup Order Intake
T0158.definition: In illegal data trading, the intake and acceptance of orders for record lookup, transaction lookup, location tracking, or similar data-query services.
T0158.description:
Data lookup order intake sits at the front of underground data-query chains. Order takers advertise that they can handle requests such as personal record lookup, transaction-record lookup, and movement tracking, collect target clues and delivery requirements from clients, and forward the work to upstream interfaces, insiders, or social-engineering database operators.

They may not own the data source themselves, but profit by aggregating demand, splitting requests, and reselling access. Controls focus on monitoring public order-intake ads, identifying query broker networks, tracing order flows, and disrupting upstream data interfaces.
T0158.usageExample: Data Lookup Order Intake ads often promise same-day results for record lookup, transaction lookup, or location-tracking requests.
